## Invitations

A total of 6713 people were invited during the reporting period. Of these, 3644 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 54.3 per cent.

The attendance figure records the number of invited people who came to the outreach activity. The rate is based on attendance compared with the total number invited. These figures provide the basis for monitoring participation and reviewing the reach of the invitation process.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded for 0 invitees. Reminders were issued to 0 invitees.

The contact figures indicate that no SMS messages or reminders were recorded as part of this outreach activity. They should be considered alongside the invitation and attendance figures when reviewing how people were contacted and how participation was supported.

This report records the invitations, attendance, and contact activity for the period covered. It was prepared by G. Evans.
